title: rosa canina var. montana
intro: Rosa canina var. montana, commonly known as the alpine rose or the wild rose, is a deciduous shrub species of rose native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. montana include its ability to promote healthy digestion and reduce inflammation, making it a popular remedy for gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
